provider.description: Review provider whose workflow to install. Omitted: toolkit.config.json's review.provider, else claude (no schema default — it would shadow the recorded one on a rerun)

mode.description: Review mode (thorough adds the over-engineering pass). Omitted: toolkit.config.json's review.mode, else standard

locale.description: Review language. Defaults to toolkit.config.json's locale, else en

maxRounds.description: Automatic review round cap per PR (bounded 1-5). Omitted: toolkit.config.json's review.maxRounds, else 3

onConflict.description: How to resolve an existing, differing workflow file. Omit to get a merge proposal (diff printed, nothing written)

dryRun.description: Print the full generated YAML, config snippet, and effective decision without writing

packageManager.description: Package manager the generated workflow installs with (default: detected, then pnpm).
